nodes.description: Constant address of the trade reserve that receives Ether and ERC20 tokens.
Fallback receive function allowing the contract to accept Ether.
External function that sends the contract's entire Ether balance to _TRADE_RESERVE.
External function that transfers the contract's entire balance of an ERC20 token to _TRADE_RESERVE.
Low-level call forwarding the contract's Ether balance to _TRADE_RESERVE.
External call to token.balanceOf(address(this)) on the provided ERC20 token.
External call to token.transfer(_TRADE_RESERVE, balance) on the provided ERC20 token.
ERC20 token contract address passed into settleERC20.
Boolean success flag returned by the low-level Ether call in settleEther.
Boolean success flag returned by token.transfer in settleERC20.

edges.reason: The constant state variable _TRADE_RESERVE is used as the target address for the low-level call in settleEther.
settleEther makes the low-level call that sends its Ether balance to _TRADE_RESERVE.
The success boolean returned by the low-level call is assigned to the local variable ok in settleEther.
settleERC20 calls token.balanceOf(address(this)) to determine the amount to transfer.
The token parameter is the contract on which balanceOf is called.
The balanceOf return value is passed as the amount argument to token.transfer.
settleERC20 calls token.transfer to send tokens to _TRADE_RESERVE.
The token parameter is the contract on which transfer is called.
The boolean returned by token.transfer is assigned to the local variable ok in settleERC20.
The constant _TRADE_RESERVE is passed as the recipient address in token.transfer.
If token is malicious, token.transfer can call back into settleEther, enabling reentrancy before the transfer returns.
If token is malicious, token.transfer can call back into settleERC20, enabling reentrancy before the transfer returns.
The low-level call to _TRADE_RESERVE can invoke a fallback that reenters settleEther, although no state is changed after the call.

normalization_plan.reason: The token parameter is only used within settleERC20 to call external token methods; normalize it into the enclosing function.
The local variable ok only holds the success flag of the low-level call; normalize it into the unsafe operation that produces it.
The local variable ok only holds the success flag of token.transfer; normalize it into the unsafe operation that produces it.
